items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Well, we read something, Ron, if you remember one?

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I'll send you that number anyway. All right, I appreciate that. It's down near 51st Street in Wells, across from the little school. And his wife used to play trombone too. She was very wealthy. I don't know if you knew her, but I don't think she came from here.

No, I don't remember. He had no wife up there. He had a bar woman. That sometimes works out for the best. Well, we read something, Ron, if you remember one? Oh yeah, we had the time. Green Miner. Ha ha ha ha. 239. How you call that street? Roads, eh? Yeah. Where Jesus is there. Roads have one.
That's where the Royal Garden is right on that road.
